--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,10 +1,29 @@
-class Robot:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    @property
-    def name(self) -> str:
-        pass
-
-    def reset(self) -> None:
-        pass
+import random
+import string
+
+
+class Robot:
+    _used_names = set()
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._name = None
+        self._generate_name()
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self._name
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        if self._name:
+            self._used_names.discard(self._name)
+        self._generate_name()
+
+    def _generate_name(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            letters = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_uppercase, k=2))
+            digits = ''.join(random.choices(string.digits, k=3))
+            new_name = letters + digits
+            if new_name not in self._used_names:
+                self._used_names.add(new_name)
+                self._name = new_name
+                break
